persona: B2B SaaS product marketing associate moving up to product marketing manager
resumeText:
Karan Mehta | Bengaluru | karan.mehta@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Product Marketing Associate, Tallyrise Technologies, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Wrote positioning and messaging for the expense management product for CFOs and finance teams.
- Ran the go-to-market plan for two product launches with product, sales and design teams.
- Built pitch decks and battlecards and ran monthly sales enablement sessions for 30 account executives.
- Wrote launch blogs, case studies and product web pages for each release.
- Worked with product managers and customer success leads to agree launch dates and scope.
- Presented launch results to the leadership team each quarter.
- Tracked activation and feature adoption after each launch in Mixpanel dashboards.

Content Marketing Executive, Leafline Media, Bengaluru (2020 - 2022)
- Wrote blogs and email newsletters for B2B software clients.

EDUCATION
BA English, Christ University, 2020

SKILLS
Competitive analysis, HubSpot, Google Analytics
